vb_textbox.text: The max amount of mushrooms you can earn is 9, The way to tell which gnome will hold the most mushrooms is based on if it was lower than 3 when you select so start at random and then choose red or brown if brown yeilds the highest potential stick with brown for a couple of rotations until it drops below 3. The gnomes work in pairs so brown and purple/ red and green etc so once you find which of the colours holds the most amount of mushrooms stick with that selection until both are below 3 mushrooms on collection and switch to the other colours.
